subject: RM_Rockfinger
departures: rooted directly in a crack in a vertical stone cliff rim, not standing in soil on flat ground
branches reaching out sideways over the drop like grasping, claw-like fingers instead of a rounded or conical crown
bark as pale as the surrounding stone, nearly the same colour as the rock it grips
a very long shadow cast down the rock face and across the ground, many times the tree's own height
